name: The Kiprun Singapore 2026
short_description: The Kiprun Singapore 2026 is an open-registration half-marathon event held on September 27, 2026, in Kallang, Singapore.
ai_summary: The Kiprun Singapore 2026 is a half-marathon event scheduled for September 27, 2026, in Kallang, Singapore. Organized by MetaSport and presented by Decathlon Singapore, it offers four distance options: 21.1km, 10km, 5km, and a shorter 0.67km run, based at the Decathlon Singapore Lab. Registration is currently open for participants interested in joining any of these distances.

faqs.question: When is the Kiprun Singapore 2026 race?
faqs.answer: The Kiprun Singapore 2026 is scheduled to take place on September 27, 2026. The event will be held in Kallang, Singapore, at the Decathlon Singapore Lab venue. Runners interested in participating should mark this date, as it is the confirmed day for all race distances offered.

faqs.question: What distances can I run at the Kiprun Singapore 2026?
faqs.answer: Participants can choose from four distances at the Kiprun Singapore 2026: a 21.1km half-marathon, a 10km race, a 5km race, and a shorter 0.67km run. This range allows runners of different experience levels and fitness goals to find a suitable distance to compete in.

faqs.question: Who organizes the Kiprun Singapore 2026?
faqs.answer: The Kiprun Singapore 2026 is organized by MetaSport, and the event is presented by Decathlon Singapore. The race is based at the Decathlon Singapore Lab in Kallang, reflecting the close partnership between the organizing team and Decathlon for this Singapore-based running event.

faqs.question: Is registration still open for this race?
